name: Dummy Deck
description: Sandbox for testing new technical phrases before migration.

cards.sideA: Necesitamos ese ambiente clonado para reproducir el problema.

sideB.text: We need that environment cloned to reproduce the problem.
We need that environment cloned so we can reproduce the issue.
We need a clone of that environment to reproduce the problem.
We need that cloned environment to reproduce the problem.

cards.sideA: Necesitamos producción clonada en Blue.

sideB.text: We need production cloned in Blue.
We need a clone of production in Blue.
We need a production clone on Blue.

cards.sideA: Necesitamos el ambiente de producción clonado en Blue.

sideB.text: We need the production environment cloned in Blue.
We need the production environment cloned onto Blue.
We need a clone of the production environment in Blue.

cards.sideA: Así puedo estar más involucrado en tus procesos.

sideB.text: That way I can be more involved in your processes.
That way I can get more involved in your processes.
This way I can be more hands-on with your processes.

cards.sideA: Vuelvo en un minuto.

sideB.text: I'll be back in a minute.
Back in a minute.
I'll be right back.
I'll be right back in a minute.

cards.sideA: Ya regreso.

sideB.text: I'm coming right back.
I'll be back shortly.
Be right back.
I'm coming back.
I'll be back soon.
I'll be right back.

cards.sideA: Sí, estoy acá, solo que el audio se sobrepone con ambos micrófonos abiertos.

sideB.text: Yes, I'm here, it's just that the audio overlaps when both microphones are open.
Yes, I'm here, the audio just overlaps with both mics open.
Yes, I'm here, it's just that having both microphones open makes the audio overlap.

cards.sideA: El audio se sobrepone al tener los 2 micrófonos abiertos.

sideB.text: The audio overlaps when both microphones are open.
The audio overlaps when you have both mics on.
Having both microphones open causes the audio to overlap.
The audio overlaps when 2 microphones are open.
The audio gets overlapped when both microphones are open.

cards.sideA: Se supone que este arreglada eso.

sideB.text: That's supposed to be fixed.
That's supposed to already be fixed.
That issue is supposed to be fixed already.

cards.note: ~It's supposed to be fixed that~ is incorrect because you cannot use both [It] and [that] as subjects/objects in this way. You can say [That is supposed to be fixed] or [It is supposed to be fixed].

cards.sideA: Ahora mismo no puedo emular la aplicacion, estoy de manos atadas.

sideB.text: Right now I can't emulate the application, my hands are tied.
I can't emulate the app right now, my hands are tied.
Right now I can't run the emulator for the app; there's nothing I can do.

cards.note: ~Right now I can't emulate the application, I'm hands tied~ is incorrect. The correct idiom is [my hands are tied], not "I'm hands tied".

cards.sideA: Ahora mismo estoy de manos atadas, no puedo testearlo.

sideB.text: Right now my hands are tied, I can't test it.
My hands are tied right now, so I can't test it.
I can't test it right now, there's nothing I can do.

cards.note: ~Right now I'm hands tied, I can't test it~ is incorrect because the expression is [my hands are tied]. You cannot say "I'm hands tied".

cards.sideA: Actualiza las fichas de marca ahora.

sideB.text: Update the brand tiles now.
Update the brand tiles right now.
Go ahead and update the brand tiles now.

cards.sideA: Toca cada tarjeta de marca aquí.

sideB.text: Tap each brand tile here.
Tap on each brand tile here.
Tap each brand card here.

cards.note: In UI design, a [tile] is usually a flat, clickable square or rectangle that navigates to a new section or launches an app, whereas a [card] often contains more complex, heterogeneous information (text, images, buttons) grouped together.

cards.sideA: Los bloques de marca mejoraron las ventas.

sideB.text: Brand tiles improved sales.
Brand tiles boosted sales.
The brand tiles improved sales performance.
Brand tiles improved the sales.

cards.sideA: La conversacion se perdio para siempre, o solo temporalmente?

sideB.text: Is the conversation lost forever, or only temporarily?
Is the conversation lost for good, or only temporarily?
Is the conversation gone forever, or just for now?

cards.sideA: Cuando A es diferente de B, podemos acceder.

sideB.text: When A is different from B, we can access it.
When A differs from B, we can gain access.
We can access it when A is different from B.
When A is different to B, we can access it.

cards.sideA: Cuando B es igual a A, no podemos ver la seccion.

sideB.text: When B is equal to A, we can't see the section.
When B equals A, we can't view the section.
We can't see the section when B is equal to A.

cards.note: ~When B is equal from A~ is incorrect because the adjective 'equal' is always followed by the preposition [to], not 'from'.

cards.sideA: Me tomo ensayo y error hacerlo.

sideB.text: It took me trial and error to do it.
It took me some trial and error to get it done.
I got it done through trial and error.

cards.sideA: Me tomo un tiempo realmente, y fue ensayo y error.

sideB.text: It really took me a while, and it was trial and error.
It actually took some time, and it was all trial and error.
It took a while, honestly, through trial and error.

cards.sideA: Las bandeja contienen múltiples artículos.

sideB.text: Flats contain multiple items.
Flats hold multiple items.
A flat contains several items.
Trays contain multiple items.

cards.sideA: Las unidades son artículos individuales.

sideB.text: Units are single items.
Units are individual items.
A unit is a single item.

cards.sideA: Las devoluciones usan bandejas.

sideB.text: Returns use flats.
Returns are processed using flats.
Flats are used for returns.
Returns use trays.

cards.sideA: Nos estamos complicando innecesariamente.

sideB.text: We're overcomplicating things unnecessarily.
We're making this harder than it needs to be.
We're needlessly overcomplicating this.
We're complicating unnecessarily.
We're overcomplicating unnecessarily.

cards.note: ~We're getting in trouble unnecessarily~ changes the meaning. To [get in trouble] means to be punished or caught doing something wrong, not to make a task more complex.

cards.sideA: No estoy seguro en este momento, pero déjame revisar el código y te daré la respuesta.

sideB.text: I am not sure right now, but let me check the code and I will give you the answer.
I'm not sure at the moment, but let me look at the code and I'll get back to you with an answer.
I'm not certain right now, but let me review the code and I'll give you the answer.
I'm not sure at the moment, but let me look at the code and I'll let you know.

cards.sideA: No lo sé en este momento, pero déjame mirar el código y te diré pronto.

sideB.text: I do not know right away, but let me look at the code and I will tell you soon.
I don't know off the top of my head, but let me check the code and I'll let you know soon.
I'm not sure at the moment, but let me look at the code and I'll tell you shortly.
I do not know at this moment, but let me look at the code and I will tell you soon.

cards.sideA: No estoy seguro ahora mismo, pero déjame revisar el código rápidamente y te avisaré.

sideB.text: I am not sure right now, but let me check the code quickly and I will let you know.
I'm not sure right now, but let me quickly check the code and I'll let you know.
I'm not certain at the moment, but let me take a quick look at the code and I'll get back to you.

cards.sideA: No está sobreescribiendo lo que nos llega del backend, no hay problema.

sideB.text: It's not overwriting what we get from the backend, so there's no problem.
It isn't overwriting what comes in from the backend, no issue there.
There's no problem, it's not overwriting the data coming from the backend.
It's not overwriting what we received from the backend, so there's no problem.

cards.sideA: Aprovechando el momento, queria preguntarte..

sideB.text: While I have the chance, I wanted to ask you something.
Taking advantage of the moment, I wanted to ask you.
Since I have you here, I wanted to ask you something.
Taking advantage of the moment, I would like to ask you.

cards.sideA: Estamos esperando la instancia RED para testear la solucion ahi.

sideB.text: We're waiting for the RED instance to test the solution there.
We're waiting on the RED instance so we can test the solution there.
We're still waiting for the RED instance to test the fix there.

cards.sideA: Con respecto a su propuesta, necesitamos más tiempo para revisar los detalles.

sideB.text: Regarding your proposal, we need more time to review the details.
With respect to your proposal, we need more time to go over the details.
Regarding your proposal, we need some extra time to review the details.

cards.sideA: A pesar del clima, el evento al aire libre se llevará a cabo según lo programado.

sideB.text: Regardless of the weather, the outdoor event will proceed as scheduled.
Despite the weather, the outdoor event will go ahead as planned.
Regardless of the weather, the outdoor event will take place as scheduled.

cards.sideA: La seccion esta disponible en la pantalla de inicio.

sideB.text: The section is available on the home screen.
The section is available on the home page.
You can find the section on the home screen.

cards.sideA: La rama local esta al dia con la rama remota.

sideB.text: The local branch is up to date with the remote branch.
The local branch is even with the remote branch.
The local branch is in sync with the remote branch.

cards.note: ~The local branch is up to date from the remote branch~ is incorrect because the expression [up to date] is followed by the preposition [with], not 'from'.

cards.sideA: La rama local esta adelantada a la rama remota.

sideB.text: The local branch is ahead of the remote branch.
The local branch is ahead of the remote one.
The local branch has commits the remote branch doesn't.

cards.note: ~The local branch is ahead from the remote branch~ is incorrect because the preposition used with 'ahead' is [of], not 'from'.

cards.sideA: La rama local esta detras de la rama remota.

sideB.text: The local branch is behind the remote branch.
The local branch is behind the remote one.
The local branch is lagging behind the remote branch.

cards.note: ~The local branch is behind from/of/to the remote branch~ are all incorrect. The word [behind] acts directly as the preposition here, so it doesn't need 'from', 'of', or 'to'. It is simply [behind the remote branch].

cards.sideA: Solo espero que no se corte la luz.

sideB.text: I just hope the power doesn't go out.
I just hope we don't lose power.
I only hope the electricity doesn't go out.
I just hope the power doesn't cut off.
I just hope the power doesn't cut out.
I just hope the power doesn't go off.

cards.sideA: Click en los 3 puntos, y luego busca configuración.

sideB.text: Click the 3 dots, and then look for settings.
Click on the three dots, then find settings.
Click the three-dot icon and then go to settings.
Click the 3 dots, and then look for configuration.

cards.sideA: busca los 3 puntos y dale click ahí.

sideB.text: Find the 3 dots and click there.
Look for the three dots and click on them.
Find the three-dot icon and tap it.
